items.title: Formal local structure of a flat family at a split node of the fibre: completed local ring is O_{S,s}^wedge[[x, y]]/(xy - h)
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives the completed normal form of a family at a split node (statement lines 5136-5152). The proof (lines 5154-5232) is a genuine approximation argument: the correction step rewrites the defect uv - h = sum f_i b_i and redistributes each b_i along the surjective mod-m generators u-bar, v-bar, lowering the defect to m^{n+1} B with an explicit formula for u', v', h'; the iteration plus completeness produces the limit relation, and the closing isomorphism uses flatness with the mod-m criterion. H3: the bookkeeping of the correction step and the order-by-order control are a real construction, not a reference chase.
